The Crossing

India and Mexico at one table.

We look for real overlaps and say how sure we are. “Supported” means the history is well established. “Analogy” means a good comparison, not a claim of shared origin. “Unresolved” means we do not know.

Themes

Chile
Supported
IndiaChile peppers reached India in the 1500s, carried by Portuguese trade.
MexicoChile peppers were domesticated in Mexico.
NASHANASHA cooks with chile from both kitchens: dried guajillo and ancho beside Indian red chiles, each for a different job.

NoteOrigin in Mexico is well established. The exact route and year into India are still debated, so we state neither.

Toasted spice, seed and nut
Analogy
IndiaMany Indian sauces start by toasting and grinding spices, seeds or nuts.
MexicoMany Mexican sauces, including mole, toast and grind chiles, seeds and nuts.
NASHAOur Toasted Seed & Chile Vegetable Bowl uses this shared technique. It is our own dish.

NoteThe similarity is a coincidence of technique. We found no evidence of a shared history and we do not claim one.

Acid
Analogy
IndiaTamarind, lime, yogurt and pickles bring sourness.
MexicoLime, vinegar, tamarind and pickled onion bring sourness.
NASHATamarind-chile glaze, lime slaw, pickled onion: acid to balance fat and heat.

NoteBoth cuisines use tamarind. How it reached Mexico is unresolved, so we make no origin claim.

Fire and char
Analogy
IndiaThe tandoor: a hot clay oven for marinated meats, vegetables and breads.
MexicoThe comal and the grill: hot surfaces for tortillas, vegetables and meats.
NASHAOur Tandoori Lamb Taco marries tandoori marination with Sonoran-style grilling. It is our own dish.

NoteTwo independent cooking systems. We compare them; we do not claim a historical link.

Flatbreads
Analogy
IndiaRoti and naan: wheat flatbreads.
MexicoTortillas of corn, and flour tortillas in the north.
NASHACorn and flour tortillas carry our fillings; flatbread logic returns in our later pizza idea.

NoteA human story is documented: Punjabi men and Mexican women formed families in California in the early 1900s. It is diaspora history, not a trade of recipes.

Rice and grain
Unresolved
IndiaRice dishes such as biryani, steamed in a sealed pot.
MexicoMaize in all its forms; rice also appears in Mexican meals.
NASHABiryani is a later idea, waiting for a cook who can judge it. We will not use a regional name unless it is earned.

NoteWe make no claim about origins of biryani or of dum cooking; the stories are folklore.

Lentils and beans
Analogy
IndiaDal: lentils simmered long and finished with spiced butter or oil.
MexicoFrijoles: beans simmered long, often with epazote.
NASHAOur Dal-Frijol Dip is built on this shared patience. It is our own dish.

NoteBoth are slow-simmered staples. Nothing more is claimed.

Fermentation
Supported
IndiaFermented drinks are documented in Indian texts, including a grain drink in the Rigveda.
MexicoChemical residue at Teotihuacan (about AD 200 to 550) is the earliest direct evidence of pulque found so far.
NASHABeer is our fermentation. It is a European-style craft beer program, not a revival of either tradition.

NoteThese are parallel human inventions with no established connection.

NASHA is an Indo-Mex kitchen in the sense of a designed fusion. We do not claim any dish is traditional to either country.

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development.

The name was chosen by the founder. Legal clearance of the name is pending. Nothing here claims trademark ownership. There is no brewery, restaurant or truck open, and nothing is for sale.

In Hindi and Urdu, nasha means intoxication or addiction. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated by food and beer. We take that meaning seriously and will never present excess or addiction as something to admire. Cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Menu items are designs for testing, not served food. Heat levels and vegetarian labels describe how a dish is designed, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly. Alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.

Illustrations on this site are original vector drawings made for this project. See how we track asset rights. Build of 2026-10-11.
